metadata.provenanceNote: Rolling seven-day publication assembled from approved official cinema sources.

films.descriptionZh: 网络混搭女王携地下幻灯派对带来一场视听狂欢。
films.descriptionEn: Internet’s original mixtape queen 1-800-HOT-DUCK returns to New York with FUGUE SPA to present a wild, underground slide-show and video party titled “THATS ENTERTAINMENT!”—a high-energy, can't-miss audio-visual spectacle.

films.canonicalTitle: 2026 Sundance Festival Short Film Tour (Open Captioning)
films.displayTitle: 2026 Sundance Festival Short Film Tour (Open Captioning)
films.descriptionZh: 本单元从本年电影节遴选六部短片，包括若干评审奖得主，呈现多样国际短片样貌。
films.descriptionEn: A curated selection of six standout short films from the festival program, including Jury Award winners, offering a cross‑section of nonfiction and narrative work from around the world compiled into a single tour program.

films.canonicalTitle: 2026 Sundance Film Festival Short Film Tour
films.displayTitle: 2026 Sundance Film Festival Short Film Tour
films.descriptionZh: 从本届圣丹斯影展遴选出的短片合集，呈现多样题材与导演视角。
films.descriptionEn: A curated program of short films drawn from this year’s Sundance Film Festival, gathering diverse voices and genres into a single showcase that highlights contemporary short filmmaking and emerging directors.

films.descriptionZh: 上世纪六十年代的小说家周在写作与情感之间游走，借虚构与现实交织出丰腴的忧郁。
films.descriptionEn: A sort-of sequel revisiting Chow as a suave science-fiction writer in 1960s settings, intercutting his affairs with scenes from his novel set in the year 2046 to craft a film of voluptuous melancholy and memory.

films.descriptionZh: 三位女职员联手对抗自负的男上司，把办公室变成理想化的职场范例。
films.descriptionEn: Three working women, bound by shared resentment toward their sexist boss, seize an unexpected chance for revenge and transform their male-dominated office into a model workplace, turning fantasy into satirical reality.

films.descriptionZh: 杨氏青春记忆中六〇年代台湾的黑帮、政治压抑与美国流行文化的交织图景。
一名流浪者被发掘成媒体巨星，权力腐蚀其人。
films.descriptionEn: An Arkansas drifter is discovered by a small‑station producer and becomes an overnight media sensation, rising to great fame and influence—and risking exposure as the fraud he has become.

films.descriptionZh: 被克隆回归的里普利在太空船上与新一代异形相遇，血缘与敌意交织。
一對老年夫妻在最後分離邊緣，以冷峻鏡頭記錄日常的窒息與溫柔。
films.descriptionEn: A study of an elderly couple facing the cruel finality of death, rendered in brittle, carefully composed framings that create an air of slow suffocation; hard and tender depictions trace the intimacy and deterioration of their shared life.

films.descriptionZh: 鳏夫参加选妻“试镜”，却发现心仪者并非表面那般无害。
films.descriptionEn: A widower attends a special audition arranged by a friend to find a new wife; the woman he fancies turns out to be far different from how she initially appears, leading the story to shift dramatically from its opening guise.

films.descriptionZh: 爱尔兰青年巴里改名改命，沉浮于18世纪欧洲的军旅、间谍與赌局之间，最终难以赢得真正的接纳。
films.descriptionEn: Redmond Barry leaves Ireland after a fatal duel and pursues fortune across 18th-century Europe as a soldier, spy, and gambler; he marries into aristocracy for wealth but ultimately finds the acceptance he seeks eludes him.

films.descriptionZh: 用象征身体与神祇的三位主角展开一场原始而抽象的仪式影像。
films.descriptionEn: An abstract, ritualistic film that names its principal figures as God Killing Himself, Mother Earth, and Son of Earth — a cinematic exploration of what those personae do to and with one another.

films.descriptionZh: 新婚在即的Bird回故乡筹婚时，真相与幻想在家庭与种族议题中碰撞。
奥菲斯传说在里约贫民区以森巴与狂欢重述。
films.descriptionEn: The Orpheus and Eurydice legend is transposed to the favelas of Rio, propelled by bossa nova rhythms and carnival fever as a lovesick hero pursues his ill‑fated beloved into the underworld amid exploding local color and dance.

films.descriptionZh: 日常将人碾为尘土，梦境成了逃生与疯狂的庇护所。
教授在古老档案中追踪疑似被梵蒂冈掩盖的时间观看装置，走入文字与阴谋的迷宫。

films.canonicalTitle: Common Carrier | Four by James N. Kienitz Wilkins
films.displayTitle: Common Carrier | Four by James N. Kienitz Wilkins
films.descriptionZh: 多段影像与对话重叠，围绕“工作”与创作生活展开。
在关闭戏院的最后一天，员工与边缘人命运交织。
侯孝贤以当代台北为中心，讲述一位年轻女子如何努力稳住濒临崩裂的家庭。
一位母亲在女儿死后成为胚胎的监护人，跨代情感与身份纠葛缓缓展开。
两个男人为同一女人相爱，情感与自然画面交织。
films.descriptionEn: A fugitive from the slums of Chicago and a shy, wealthy Texan vie for the love of Abby, the story unfolding through striking images and sound in Terrence Malick’s film following Badlands.

films.descriptionZh: 一个迷恋流行歌手的少女在遭到轻视后走向极端，成为令人不安的心理慢燃惊悚。
films.descriptionEn: Teen runaway Simone’s obsessive love for pop singer “R” turns dark when their real‑life meeting exposes her idol’s callousness, setting off a slow‑burn psychological thriller of parasocial obsession that culminates in a chilling final act.

films.descriptionZh: 少年卡尔渴望父爱，却被偏爱兄长；为爱与接受，他揭露母亲秘密，撕裂家庭。
films.descriptionEn: Teenage Cal Trask yearns for the affection his father reserves for his brother; frustrated and attracted to his brother’s girlfriend, Cal reveals a long-held secret about their mother, a disclosure that tears the family apart.

films.descriptionZh: 新版改编聚焦特拉斯克家族与反派凯西。
films.descriptionEn: This fresh interpretation of Steinbeck’s multigenerational saga explores the Trask family while placing new focus on its indelible antihero, Cathy Ames.

films.descriptionZh: 在匈牙利广袤的草原上，古希腊神话被极简长镜头重述，成为对暴政与反抗的冥想。
films.descriptionEn: A hypnotic retelling of the Electra myth set on Hungary’s vast puszta, composed of a handful of intricately staged long takes that transform the ancient tale into a timeless meditation on tyranny and rebellion.

films.descriptionZh: 音樂影像化再現伊娃·裴隆的奢華崛起與落幕。
films.descriptionEn: A lavish, visually driven musical adaptation that traces Eva Perón’s meteoric rise and tragic end, staging grand crowd scenes and constant costume changes to recreate her public ascent and its dramatic resonance.

films.descriptionZh: 王家卫拍夜香港：杀手、失恋者与擦肩而过的欲望。
一部由零散短段拼成的滑稽冷面叙事，勾勒当代巴黎的上流与下层风貌。
films.descriptionEn: A deadpan formalist comedy composed of seemingly disparate blackout sketches that assemble into a panorama of high- and lowlife in contemporary Paris, linked by exquisite tracking shots and wryly observed character vignettes.

films.descriptionZh: 一位百岁女性登台试镜，独白中揭示公众视野下的奇异真相。
films.descriptionEn: An elderly woman in her centenarian years arrives to audition for a Broadway play and, standing alone on stage, reveals strange truths about a life lived in the public eye and the woman the world thought she knew.

films.descriptionZh: 两位导演携手呈现围绕一位囚犯与相关争议的纪实叙事。
films.descriptionEn: Acclaimed directors collaborate on a documentary that examines the contested story of Leonard Peltier, tracing the events and disputes surrounding his case through investigative storytelling.

films.canonicalTitle: Ghost in the Shell: 30th Anniversary Remaster
films.displayTitle: Ghost in the Shell: 30th Anniversary Remaster
films.descriptionZh: 2029年，半机械化的少校追踪一个在信息海洋中诞生的神秘存在。
films.descriptionEn: In 2029 a cyborg Major tracks an omnipotent entity born in a sea of information—an ambiguous hacker or virus threatening world order—while the animation blends hand-drawn and CGI techniques to render her physical and existential journey.

films.descriptionZh: 退伍青年被卷入犯罪世界与危险三角恋。
films.descriptionEn: Released from military service, Makdong returns to a changed hometown, rescues a young woman, and is unwittingly lured into the criminal underworld, entering a dangerous love triangle with a local crime boss and facing dire consequences.

films.descriptionZh: 讽刺又辛辣的校园黑色喜剧，毒舌与暗黑笑料交织。
films.descriptionEn: A cynical, surreal dark high‑school comedy that masks sharper themes beneath gleefully nasty putdowns and iconic performances; its bitter humor and memorable lines have made it one of the most influential teen films in modern times.

films.descriptionZh: 一名工业家在误以为儿子被绑後陷入绑架风暴，影片以精确构图与惊险场面探讨正义與阶级。
爵士夜总会里，两位朋友在名利、贪婪与谋杀威胁下命运改写。
films.descriptionEn: At a steamy nightclub, pianist Percival keeps to the rules while Rooster dazzles on stage; their friendship and the club unravel when greed, fame, and a violent turn threaten to destroy them and the place they call home.

films.descriptionZh: 一位白人寡妇与黑人单亲母亲结识，命运交织。
films.descriptionEn: In 1940s New York, a white widow who dreams of Broadway has a chance encounter with a black single mother who becomes her maid, and their lives become intertwined.

films.descriptionZh: 一位攝影師認為外星「希克索斯」正促成文明衰敗，精神崩潰逐漸顯現。
深夜取餐的朋友被困於無盡公路，面對不可名狀的恐怖。
films.descriptionEn: Friends on a late-night food run become trapped on an endless highway where otherworldly terrors lurk outside their Jeep Cherokee, forcing them to choose between accepting fate or attempting escape.

films.descriptionZh: 当恶魔附身，吉妮佛转而猎食校园中的男生，好友尼迪誓要阻止血腥恶行。
films.descriptionEn: After a demon possesses high-school girl Jennifer, she begins preying on the male population of her school; her nerdy friend Needy discovers what’s happening and vows to stop the carnage.

films.descriptionZh: 一名大一生在看似平静的海滨小镇发现惊人阴谋，夹杂荒诞对话与血腥笑料。
一位乡村侦探在纽约调查失踪案，牵出危险线索。
films.descriptionEn: A small‑town police detective comes to New York to investigate his friend’s disappearance; his only lead is a letter to Bree Daniels, and as attraction develops he realizes she may be the murderer’s real target.

films.canonicalTitle: Knife: The Attempted Murder of Salman Rushdie
films.displayTitle: Knife: The Attempted Murder of Salman Rushdie
films.descriptionZh: 围绕对作家萨尔曼·鲁西迪的刺杀未遂及其背景展开。
films.descriptionEn: More than thirty years after Ayatollah Khomeini called for Salman Rushdie’s death over The Satanic Verses, the film examines the attempted murder and its aftermath, beginning with Rushdie’s speaking engagement in Chautauqua, NY.

films.descriptionZh: 巴黎郊区三位青年在骚乱后的一天，怒火不断逼近爆点。
勞倫斯在沙漠中聯合阿拉伯部落，掀起對奧斯曼帝國的戰爭與身世探索。
films.descriptionEn: A sweeping biography traces an enigmatic desert-loving Englishman who unites Arab tribes to fight the Ottoman Turks during World War I, presenting a complex portrait of his character and deeds.

films.canonicalTitle: Lost Landscapes of New York with Rick Prelinger
films.displayTitle: Lost Landscapes of New York with Rick Prelinger
films.descriptionZh: 观众与影像共筑纽约城市交响，现场为放映配乐并参与回忆与讨论。

films.canonicalTitle: Lost Landscapes of San Francisco with Rick Prelinger
films.displayTitle: Lost Landscapes of San Francisco with Rick Prelinger
films.descriptionZh: 影像汇聚旧金山百年瞬间，观众现场即兴构成电影配乐与记忆。
帕索里尼以梅黛亚为象征，讲述被抛弃的女巫因骗局而走向复仇的悲剧。
两名侦探联手追查乡间连环杀人案，调查将他们推向失败与绝望的边缘。
一名浪漫的編劇在巴黎午夜穿越到爵士年代，重新檢視人生選擇。
一位作家憎恶社会伪装，却发现坦率并非易事。
films.descriptionEn: Alice, a brilliant novelist who despises the carefully constructed lies of modern society, confronts the complexities of truth in a razor-sharp reimagining of Molière’s dark comedy.

films.descriptionZh: 在特拉维夫屋顶的秘密对话中，以色列人揭露加沙大屠杀的系统设计与运作。
films.descriptionEn: Through secret rooftop conversations in Tel Aviv, Israeli filmmakers and journalists reveal the systems behind the calculated mass killing of Palestinian civilians in Gaza, drawing on the testimony of those who designed and operated them.

films.descriptionZh: 一部低成本庞克风格改编片，描绘孤独发型师与邂逅者的故事。
films.descriptionEn: A low-budget, punk‑porn reinterpretation of a Robert Altman film, following a lonely gay hairdresser who picks up a beautiful stranger, reworking the story into a transgressive underground narrative.

films.descriptionZh: 以感官影像改写奥德赛，语言杂糅为咒语般的回忆與抒情景致，画面之美令人难忘。
片中如手记般思绪流动，准备在非洲拍摄改编古希腊悲剧。
女儿被招募为间谍赴潜伏纳粹之人身边，而她与招募者之间也逐渐情愫暗生，风险骤增。
大蕭條時期，越獄三人組沿密西西比展開荒誕尋愛旅程，途遇詩意與惡徒。
出狱男子与身患重度脑性麻痹的女子在隐秘相会中建立非凡情感，对抗世俗残酷。
从神话出发，讲述无知的命运将一人推入与母亲的悲剧纠葛。
films.descriptionEn: A reworking of Sophocles’ tragedy that begins with a prologue in prewar Italy and follows Oedipus as an unwitting victim of his own ignorance, staged with color, stylized costumes, and an almost science-fiction vision of the ancient world.

films.descriptionZh: 梦境记录技术外泄，潜意识影像与现实交织威胁城市秩序。
films.descriptionEn: In a near future where therapists can record dreams with the DC Mini, the theft of a prototype causes subconscious images to bleed into reality, sparking a race to prevent a psychedelic dream apocalypse on the streets.

films.canonicalTitle: Pretty in Pink x Straight White Men Can't Dance
films.displayTitle: Pretty in Pink x Straight White Men Can't Dance
films.descriptionZh: 围绕青春电影与美国男性气质的讨论，含作者对话与签书活动。
films.descriptionEn: A spotlight on a teen romance film paired with a conversation about American masculinity in film and popular culture, featuring a Q&A and book signing with the author alongside a featured star.

films.descriptionZh: 太极师傅搬到纽约，与美式化家庭的代际文化冲突以温柔幽默展现。
films.descriptionEn: A widowed tai chi master relocates from Beijing to New York to live with his Americanized son and white daughter‑in‑law, and cultural and generational tensions—compounded by language barriers—are dramatized with compassion and gentle humor.

films.descriptionZh: 台北街头的都市孤独与欲望纠缠，少年在游戏厅与小混混间展开复仇与压抑的情感。
在反乌托邦的底特律，义体警察穿梭于公司权力与犯罪之间。
纪录片跟随坂本龍一在确诊癌症后重返创作，将对死亡意识化为音乐。
films.descriptionEn: An intimate portrait that follows Ryuichi Sakamoto as he returns to composing after a cancer diagnosis, channeling a renewed awareness of mortality into his latest musical work.

films.descriptionZh: 镜头记录作曲家确诊后三年半的生活、病疗与创作，亲近而温柔。
车库摇滚乐队的贝斯手遇上滑板女孩，却要面对她的一群前任追逐者。
films.descriptionEn: As the bass player in a garage‑rock band, Scott Pilgrim falls for Ramona Flowers, only to discover she carries an army of vengeful ex‑boyfriends who challenge him in increasingly literal, comic‑book‑style battles.

films.descriptionZh: 巴黎，丧女父亲与神秘精神科医展开追凶复仇之路，正义与执念模糊。
films.descriptionEn: A grieving father and a mysterious psychiatrist embark on a ruthless quest for vengeance after his daughter is murdered, abducting and interrogating suspects across Paris as the line between justice and obsession begins to blur.

films.descriptionZh: 一群普罗旺斯小镇学童与老师的松散片段，描绘从童年到青春的初恋、孤独與危险。
塔可夫斯基的太空哲思：记忆、愧疚与无法复原的爱。
两位青少年在堪萨斯的爱情因家庭与性压抑而破碎。
films.descriptionEn: Two teenage lovers in 1928 Kansas struggle with intimacy and sexual pressures learned from overbearing parents, thwarting their hopes for happiness in this romantic drama.

films.descriptionZh: 十九岁的露西前往托斯卡纳别墅，追寻母亲踪迹与初吻的回忆，同时面对众多追求者。
六位好友在路易斯安那小镇中分享笑泪，面对爱情與失落。
films.descriptionEn: Six close friends in a small Louisiana parish share life’s joys and sorrows—bonding over love, laughter, and grief as they navigate the trials of family and friendship.

films.descriptionZh: 工人出身的斯特拉为女儿牺牲，最终选择放手。
films.descriptionEn: Working‑class Stella marries into wealth and, after their separation, centers her life on daughter Laurel—coming to realize that Laurel can flourish without her.

films.canonicalTitle: Still Film + Q&A | Four by James N. Kienitz Wilkins
films.displayTitle: Still Film + Q&A | Four by James N. Kienitz Wilkins
films.descriptionZh: 以法庭笔录式旁白与影像靶列，检视影像文化与真相的变形。
一家人为一场悼念聚首，真相渐次浮现。
films.descriptionEn: A family gathers for a commemorative ritual whose nature only gradually becomes clear as relationships and memories surface over the course of the day.

films.descriptionZh: 一部同志朋克影人自白式影作，呈现疲态导演的创作与混乱。
films.descriptionEn: A queer‑punk riff on Fellini’s 8½ in which a washed‑up underground filmmaker and porn star contends with creative collapse and personal chaos, presented with the director starring as himself.

films.descriptionZh: 失業男子為籌腎臟移植經費捲入綁架計畫，絕望逐漸演變為暴力的連鎖反應。
一部围绕连结、照护與身份的英文剧情片，伴随创作者与演员对谈。

films.canonicalTitle: Teenage Sex and Death at Camp Miasma
films.displayTitle: Teenage Sex and Death at Camp Miasma
films.descriptionZh: 一位年轻导演前往拜访退隐的原片女星，兩人陷入充滿慾望與恐懼的血腥世界，面對重生與自我實現的試煉。
films.descriptionEn: A young director aiming to revive a camp slasher franchise visits the original film’s reclusive star; their encounter pulls both women into a surreal, bloody world of desire, fear, and delirium under threat from the menacing Little Death.

films.descriptionZh: 背包客受邀到泰國無人島，假期小社群引發危機與衝突。

films.canonicalTitle: The Best Little Whorehouse in Texas
films.displayTitle: The Best Little Whorehouse in Texas
films.descriptionZh: 当地方名声受威胁，庄园女主人和警长携手保卫并找到爱情。
films.descriptionEn: When a television crusader threatens to expose the local brothel, its proprietress teams up with the sheriff to fight to keep it open—along the way they join forces and find unexpected romance.

films.canonicalTitle: The Bridge on the River Kwai
films.displayTitle: The Bridge on the River Kwai
films.descriptionZh: 一名英军上校在战俘中执著建桥，引发对职责与痴迷的冲突。
films.descriptionEn: A principled British colonel becomes obsessed with leading POWs to build a bridge for their captors in wartime Burma, setting up a tense clash between duty, pride, and obsession.

films.descriptionZh: 故事在小镇与越战残酷之间拉扯，展现生活与战争对人的摧残与影响。
films.descriptionEn: The film balances an intimate study of small-town American life with the brutality and horror of the Vietnam War, following characters whose lives are profoundly altered by the conflict and its aftermath.

films.descriptionZh: 一名怯弱上班族發現有個與自己互換身份的雙胞格外同事，生活急轉直下。
纪录片以混合幽默與情感的方式，追索混凝土作为纽约基石的故事与意义。
脱离电视秀后，导演探索以贺卡片式公式来纪录混凝土与日常美学的可能性。
films.descriptionEn: After ending his TV show, a filmmaker attends a workshop on writing Hallmark movies and then tries to apply that formula to a documentary about concrete, searching for a new creative outlet and approach.

films.descriptionZh: 偏远苏格兰岛上，兄妹捕猎海鸟并讲述祖辈故事。
films.descriptionEn: On a remote Scottish isle, siblings Isla and Sandy spend their days hunting seabirds and retelling the stories of their ancestors, living a rugged, insular life shaped by family lore.

films.descriptionZh: 聚焦极限登山行业与文化变迁，通过一趟2021年远征层层剖析。
films.descriptionEn: A probing look at the industry and evolving culture of extreme mountain climbing that focuses on a 2021 expedition to unpack complex, harrowing, and moving dimensions of the sport.

films.descriptionZh: 退伍兵弗雷迪在二战后误入兰卡斯特·多德创立的新“宗教”船上，寻找归属与纷乱的人际牵绊。
films.descriptionEn: A volatile, heavy-drinking veteran with PTSD finds a semblance of family after joining the ship of Lancaster Dodd, the charismatic leader who forms a new postwar religion; the story follows Freddie’s search for belonging amid that movement.

films.canonicalTitle: The Misconceived - 35MM | Four by James N. Kienitz Wilkins
films.displayTitle: The Misconceived - 35MM | Four by James N. Kienitz Wilkins
films.descriptionZh: 一位失败导演变木匠为旧友工作，随之卷入复杂的人际与自我较量。
films.descriptionEn: A failed filmmaker turned carpenter is hired by his estranged college friend—the now-successful sculptor—to renovate a dream vacation home, setting off an uneasy reunion that probes creativity, rivalry, and personal failure.

films.canonicalTitle: The Night is Short, Walk on Girl
films.displayTitle: The Night is Short, Walk on Girl
films.descriptionZh: 夜晚的京都奇遇记，少女在纵情狂欢中与形形色色人物相遇，展开荒诞一夜。

films.canonicalTitle: The Plagiarists | Four by James N. Kienitz Wilkins
films.displayTitle: The Plagiarists | Four by James N. Kienitz Wilkins
films.descriptionZh: 一对白人夫妇遇到一位年长黑人，随之面对原创与道德的困惑。
一名记者揭露谋杀阴谋，逐步发现两段感情皆受腐败男性社会所制约，影片以女性主义翻转黑色电影元素。

films.canonicalTitle: The Taking of Pelham One Two Three
films.displayTitle: The Taking of Pelham One Two Three
films.descriptionZh: 一列被劫持的地鐵使一名運輸警官獲得出人意表的英雄機會；放映當天有導讀與簽書會。
五位丽兹本姐妹在郊区中如幻影般漂浮，她们与男孩们的欲望引发改变人生的连锁事件。
乡村警长调查连环命案，村民怀疑一名日本流浪者是恶灵，故事充满巫术、逐魂与基督象征。
纽约帮派被诬陷后横穿全城返乡的夜行冒险。
负债司机赴韩承接刺杀任务，逃亡途中面对警匪追逐与生死抉择，配乐推动紧张节奏。
一週匆忙拍攝中，樂手在東京的工作與日常被拼貼成影像拼圖。
年仅十九岁的安东尼·布尔丹在普罗温斯敦闯入餐厅厨房，度过塑造他人生的重要夏天。
films.descriptionEn: A 19-year-old Anthony Bourdain travels to Provincetown and stumbles into the chaotic world of a restaurant kitchen, igniting a transformative summer that shapes the course of his life.

films.descriptionZh: 高速列车爆发丧尸危机，类型刺激中包裹亲情抉择。
搬到多雨小镇的比拉遇见神秘的爱德华，二人陷入既浪漫又非凡的恋情。
films.descriptionEn: Bella Swan moves from Phoenix to the rainy town of Forks and meets the mysterious Edward Cullen, whose uncanny abilities and agelessness draw them into a passionate, unorthodox romance between a human and a vampire.

films.descriptionZh: 一位归来的希腊裔电影人穿越巴尔干，寻觅三卷珍贵底片，影像中充满战争、帝国衰落與哀伤。
一位纽约钻石商沉迷赌局，命悬一线。
一位外星女性以人为食，却逐渐体会人性。
films.descriptionEn: An alien who takes human form preys on men but begins to find something like humanity within herself, rendered through moody cinematography, improvised dialogue, and an unnerving atonal score.

films.descriptionZh: 一组以女性身体为中心、对抗男权艺术的短片，包含对表演、断裂肢体与性欲的激进探讨。
兩位窮困演員郁郁不得志，誤打誤撞到鄉間度假爆發喝酒、鬥嘴與囧事。
films.descriptionEn: Two penniless actor flatmates in late‑60s London—dissolute Withnail and his unnamed companion—escape to Uncle Monty’s Lake District house and embark on a disorderly holiday of drinking, bickering, and comic excess.

films.canonicalTitle: Women on the Verge of a Nervous Breakdown
films.displayTitle: Women on the Verge of a Nervous Breakdown
films.descriptionZh: 女配音員佩帕被情人拋棄，引發一連串誇張失控的情感與喜劇事件。
films.descriptionEn: Voice actress Pepa, abandoned by her lover, resolves to kill herself with gazpacho laced with sleeping pills—an act that kicks off a gaudy, cheeky screwball melodrama of unhinged behavior, emotional excess, and tangled relationships.

films.descriptionZh: 觀察台北中產三代情感生活的溫柔長片。
films.descriptionEn: A gentle, restrained study of three generations in an upper‑middle‑class Taipei family, shifting between comic foibles and a pervasive melancholy to explore missed opportunities and the hidden emotional spaces of everyday life.

films.descriptionZh: 底特律女服务员被一位顾客引诱，踏上一场佛罗里达周末狂欢。
films.descriptionEn: Zola, a Detroit waitress, strikes up a new friendship with a customer who lures her into a weekend of dancing and partying in Florida, setting off a volatile journey through club life and risky choices.
